transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1346 Wilmington Park Lane?
Yes, this is me. My husband needs oxygen and can’t leave him alone.
Thank you for confirming your situation. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
One person here. My husband’s with me—he needs oxygen and can’t leave alone.

I heard you're here with your husband needing oxygen. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
Yes, my husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. He’s not in a wheelchair, but he’s bedbound.
I hear your husband needs oxygen and can’t leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. He’s on oxygen and can’t leave alone.
We heard you’re on oxygen and can’t leave alone. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No truck, no boat, no free seats. My husband’s on oxygen, I can’t leave him.

I hear you’re staying with your husband on oxygen. Let me read that back: 2 people; husband needs help leaving because of oxygen; he needs help leaving because of oxygen; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Yes. Just me and my husband. He’s on oxygen and can’t leave alone. No water in yet.

Got it. Stay safe. We’re listening. I've recorded that you need help leaving. No responder has been assigned yet. If water is rising inside, move to the highest floor and call 911 if you can get through. Goodbye.

house_card: Two people. Husband and he need oxygen and can't leave alone. No water inside. Language: English.
